reading:
FirstLight is headquartered at 12 Metro Park Road in Albany, New York, and describes more than 25 years in the fiber and communications industry without stating an exact founding year. Antin Infrastructure Partners acquired the company from Oak Hill Capital Partners, per Antin's own press release announcing the completed transaction.

FirstLight is primarily a regional fiber network operator, running a 20,000 route-mile network connecting more than 16,000 on-net locations across the Northeast and mid-Atlantic, serving more than 15,000 businesses across sectors including K-12 education, government, banking and finance, higher education, healthcare, and AI and hyperscaler customers. Data center colocation is one service line within this broader fiber business rather than FirstLight's core product, a positioning similar to Lumen's elsewhere in this registry. The company acquired Maine Fiber Company in 2019, per its own press release, the likely origin of its Maine-based facilities.

The registry here tracks 2 FirstLight facilities, both in Maine, consistent with the 2019 Maine Fiber Company acquisition. Because FirstLight's data centers exist to support its fiber network business rather than function as a standalone national colocation platform, its facility count and market presence should be read differently from operators like CoreSite or Equinix whose core business is colocation itself.
